about_the_game:
Tarnex Warfare is a real-time strategy game focused on realism and a dynamic frontline.

Command modern combat units, capture territory, and lead your forces through battles that reflect the chaos and pressure of real warfare. Every decision — from unit placement to calling an airstrike — can shift the balance of the fight.

Unlike traditional RTS games, Tarnex Warfare replaces base-building and resource gathering with strategic control, logistics, and morale management. The frontline moves freely and dynamically based on unit positions and combat outcomes, creating a living, ever-changing battlefield.

Plan your operations, coordinate infantry, armored vehicles, drones, and artillery, and hold your ground against superior forces. Experience modern conflict from the commander’s perspective — where a few kilometers of land can decide the outcome of an entire operation.

Core features

• Dynamic frontline — allowing for wide tactical maneuvering and evolving battle conditions.
• Realistic combat simulation — with authentic vehicle and weapon characteristics, morale, terrain effects, and many other factors that shape the course of battle.
• Modern warfare system — including infantry, vehicles, drones, artillery, communications, electronic warfare, and air support.
• Real-world maps based on OpenStreetMap data, with the ability to generate custom maps from any image.
• In-game map editor, custom missions, factions, and full mod support (in development).
• Immersive atmosphere — featuring day-night cycles, seasons, and weather effects that enhance the sense of realism and presence.[/p]

Tarnex Warfare combines the clarity of tactical maps with the intensity of real-time combat — a modern warfare experience built for strategists.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-1035G1 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (4 core)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA MX350 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (6 core)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5600 XT (6 GB)
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Command modern forces across a living frontline where every meter matters. Plan, strike, and adapt in a realistic real-time strategy of modern warfare.
